title: Composed supervisory control: Configurable batch counter -> Bounded up/down inventory counter

inputs.name: A_Target
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Batch target, assumed 1 through 100

inputs.name: B_Capacity
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Maximum count, assumed positive

outputs.name: A_Accepted
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Item accepted this scan

outputs.name: B_Conflict
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Add and Remove rose together

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Target remains constant during a test and is between 1 and 100.
Item pulses are separated by at least one low scan.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Capacity remains constant during a test and is positive.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Only a rising A_Item edge while A_Enable and below A_Target shall increment A_Count.
requirements.property: G(A_Accepted = (rose(A_Item) AND A_Enable AND prev(A_Count)<A_Target AND !A_Reset))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Count shall remain between zero and A_Target.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_BatchDone shall be TRUE when A_Count reaches A_Target.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Count, A_BatchDone, and A_Accepted.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A lone rising B_AddItem edge increments B_Count when below B_Capacity.
requirements.property: G((rose(B_AddItem) AND !rose(B_RemoveItem) AND prev(B_Count)<B_Capacity AND !B_Reset) -> B_Count=prev(B_Count)+1)

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A lone rising B_RemoveItem edge decrements B_Count when above zero.
requirements.property: G((rose(B_RemoveItem) AND !rose(B_AddItem) AND prev(B_Count)>0 AND !B_Reset) -> B_Count=prev(B_Count)-1)

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Simultaneous rising edges shall leave B_Count unchanged and set B_Conflict for one scan.
requirements.property: G((rose(B_AddItem) AND rose(B_RemoveItem) AND !B_Reset) -> ((B_Count=prev(B_Count)) AND B_Conflict))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Count shall remain within zero and B_Capacity; B_Empty and B_Full reflect the boundaries.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_Count and B_Conflict.
A TRUE A_BatchDone shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
